Title: Questionnaire: Is your neighbor a heretic?
Body:
A simple 3-question test:
1. Do they smile more than once a week?
2. Do they read books without purity seals?
3. Have they spilled sacred paste on the altar of the Omnissiah?
If you answered 'Yes' to any of these, leave their address in the comments below. The Inquisition dispatch team is already on their way.
